framing: All-model decision economics by replenishment lead time (7/14/21/28). π = revenue_proxy − inv_loss − C_model. C_hold fixed from policy; margins only change C_lost (and r). Hybrid out of selector. C_model is a transparent proxy.
caveats: C_model is NOT a measured production / cloud bill.
Primary C_model uses train wall-time normalized to the fastest model × base_per_day=0.01; fixed tiers (LGBM=1, DS=1.5, TST=1.5, TFT=2, DeepAR=2) are recorded as backup.
Revenue proxy uses shared mean_actual at the horizon when present; ranking equals minimizing inv_loss + C_model when demand is shared.
U/H are forecast-error proxies (underage / no-sale holding), not a full inventory simulation with pipeline stock.

policy.note: C_hold from inventory/finance policy (shared). Only margin varies → r = margin*price / C_hold. C_model is an explicit ops proxy.

lt_1_week.label: Lead time 1 week
lt_1_week.policy_note: Replenishment ordered today arrives after the lead time; evaluate forecast errors at horizon h=7.

crossover.rule: For r < r*: prefer lower-holding model (TST lite if it has lower H). For r > r*: prefer lower-stockout model (plain DS if it has lower U).

interpretation.left_of_r_star: Holding hurts relatively more → cooler / lower-overstock posture
interpretation.right_of_r_star: Lost sales hurt more → lower-stockout posture
